intro.title: Lord Hanuman Gemstone Idols
intro.descriptionHtml: Charming range of meticulously crafted Lord Hanuman gemstone idols enhanced with energies of gemstones. These idols portray Hanuman idol in seated, kneeling, meditating and other poses which hold varying significance. Crafted by skilled artisans, each idol is meticulously crafted from 100% natural and non-heated gemstone to provide optimum benefits of the gemstones along with blessings of the Deity. Lord Hanuman is worshipped for protection from negative influences and blessings of strength, courage, vigilance and valor. Available are idols made in Ruby, Gomedh, Jade, Sapphire, Crystal quartz and other natural gemstones.
